# Degree Controls Inc

> Degree Controls Inc provides specialized airflow and thermal management solutions for medical, automotive, data center, HVAC, and industrial applications.

Degree Controls Inc is a thermal engineering company offering embedded airflow sensors, monitoring instruments, and datacenter cooling solutions with certifications including NSF/ANSI-49 and OSHA compliance. The company serves critical industries requiring precise airflow measurement and control.

## Key Topics

- Airflow Measurement
- Thermal Management
- Embedded Sensors
- HVAC Solutions
- Data Center Cooling
- Rooster Monitoring Systems
- UAS1000 Instrumentation
- HT2-500 Cooling
- Airflow Sensors
- Industrial Applications
- Biosafety Cabinets
- Temperature-Humidity Control
- Pressure Monitoring
- Building Commissioning

## Products & Solutions

- [Embedded Airflow Sensors & Switches](https://www.degreec.com/products/embedded-airflow-sensors-switches): F/FH/B/S-Series embedded airflow sensors and switches for integration into systems
- [Airflow Tools & Instruments](https://www.degreec.com/products/airflow-tools-instruments): UAS1000 and UAS instrumentation for airflow measurement and analysis
- [Airflow and Pressure Alarms & Monitors](https://www.degreec.com/products/airflow-and-pressure-alarms-monitors): Rooster™ airflow and pressure monitoring and alarm systems for continuous supervision
- [Datacenter Underfloor Cooling & Airflow Measurement](https://www.degreec.com/products/datacenter-underfloor-cooling-airflow-measurement): HT2-500, °C Grate, and °C SPAR products for datacenter thermal efficiency
- [Products Catalog](https://www.degreec.com/products): Complete product catalog including sensors, controllers, instruments, and software solutions

## Industry Markets

- [Medical & Laboratory Solutions](https://www.degreec.com/markets/medical-laboratory): Airflow sensing solutions for biosafety cabinets and fume hoods in medical and laboratory environments
- [Technology & Data Centers](https://www.degreec.com/markets/technology-data-centers): Airflow management and thermal efficiency solutions for data center infrastructure
- [HVAC Building & Commissioning](https://www.degreec.com/markets/hvac-building-commissioning): HVAC and building commissioning airflow sensing solutions for climate control systems
- [Automotive & Transportation](https://www.degreec.com/markets/automotive-transportation): Airflow sensing and thermal management solutions for automotive and transportation applications
- [Industrial Applications](https://www.degreec.com/markets/industrial): Industrial airflow sensing and control solutions for manufacturing processes
- [Markets Overview](https://www.degreec.com/markets): Industry markets overview spanning medical, automotive, data centers, HVAC, and industrial sectors
